node.title: Tres costes de producir claridad
node.summary: Account for discovery, authorised constitution and operational absorption.

relations: A transformation business case should include the costs of looking, making binding declarations and absorbing their consequences, not only implementation expenditure.
No son tarifas ni porcentajes universales. Un esfuerzo de preparación real no es por sí mismo compensación evitable.
Upstream work should produce a focusable mission and explicit residual uncertainty before execution is compressed, with the cost of that preparation visible.
Suficiente depende del alcance y del riesgo; no se propone un umbral universal ni una fase de diagnóstico sin límite.
Focus ON can distinguish an observable operating obstacle from a still-unmade declaration of ownership, scope or priority that the diagnosis cannot simply discover.
Se propone lectura metodológica, no uso histórico del paper posterior ni un algoritmo que determine la causa a partir de una entrevista.
